builds.goal: Investigate high one fresh Titan's Wrath shield output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: W grants 50/60/70/80/90 + 8/9/10/11/12% of Nautilus maximum HP as a shield for six seconds. AP scales the separate attack burn, not this shield helper. Purchased health and legally earned Heartsteel health can increase the core shield; eligible shield modifiers are a separate check.

builds.name: Riptide: three-wave overlap
builds.summary: Explore high one three-wave Riptide sequence on one champion output under a finite benchmark; compare alternatives without claiming a solver-certified maximum.
builds.goal: Explore high one three-wave Riptide sequence on one champion output under a finite benchmark; compare alternatives without claiming a solver-certified maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each E wave has a 55/90/125/160/195 + 0.50 AP base. Source data specifies 50% extra-wave damage reduction: three actual hits on one target are nominally two first-wave equivalents, 390 + 1.0 AP at rank 5, subject to client timing and geometry.
